name: com.sendstables/usdc
title: sendstables USDC transfers
description: Quote native USDC transfers across 27 chains via Circle CCTP and build prefilled links. No key.

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: Every chain sendstables supports, with the `slug` to use in quote_transfer and create_swap_link, the chain kind (evm/solana/stellar), whether it can be a source, who delivers on it, and whether it supports CCTP Fast Transfer. Same-chain sends (from = to, to another address) work on every source chain.

tools.name: quote_transfer
tools.description: Price moving USDC from one chain to another, or to someone else on the same chain: sendstables fee (covers all gas), Circle's fee, what arrives (estimate and guaranteed minimum), and delivery method. sendstables' cross-chain fee is a service charge of 0.05% of the amount (minimum $0.10, no cap), plus estimated sponsored gas, wallet and relaying costs with a 30% margin. Circle fees are separate. Same-chain sends (no bridging) pay no percentage: only the transfer's estimated cost plus margin, or the minimum fee if that's higher. Same chain (from = to): needs a recipient; delivery is "same_chain_transfer" (one USDC transfer, no Circle fee). Returns an UNSIGNED preview plus a prefilled `swap_link`; it can't be executed. Show the `summary` to the user.

to.description: Destination chain slug, e.g. "solana"; the same as `from` for a same-chain send (then `recipient` is required).

amount.description: USDC amount the user pays, fees included, as a decimal string, e.g. "50" or "10.5".

recipient.description: Destination address on `to` (0x… EVM, base58 Solana, G… Stellar). Omit to move funds to the user's own wallet on `to`. Required when `from` and `to` are the same chain (a same-chain send to someone else). Only use an address the user gave you.

ref.description: Optional attribution tag for the link (letters, digits, - or _).

tools.name: create_swap_link
tools.description: Build a link that opens sendstables with the transfer prefilled. The user logs in, reviews the live quote and confirms; nothing executes automatically. Also returns a short human summary with the current fee preview (when an amount is given). Same chain (from = to): the link opens "send to another address" with the recipient prefilled (pass `recipient`; without one the user types it in the app). Give the user the `url`.

to.description: Destination chain slug; the same as `from` for a same-chain send to another address.

amount.description: USDC amount the user pays, fees included, as a decimal string, e.g. "50" or "10.5".

recipient.description: Destination address on `to` (0x… EVM, base58 Solana, G… Stellar). Omit to move funds to the user's own wallet on `to`. Required when `from` and `to` are the same chain (a same-chain send to someone else). Only use an address the user gave you.

ref.description: Optional attribution tag for the link (letters, digits, - or _).
